Page 2 – Important Security Notice
IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTICE
Please Read This Page Carefully Before Making Any Payment
Your safety and your ﬁnancial security are very important to us.
Unfortunately, fraud is common in international recruitment. Some individuals or
companies may falsely claim that they represent EuroJobsCenter or work together with
our company. Others may use copied logos, forged documents, fake websites, fake
social media accounts, or even fake stamps and signatures.
For your own protection, please read and follow the instructions below.

subsection_title: 1. EuroJobsCenter Does Not Normally Accept Advance Payments
text:
1. EuroJobsCenter Does Not Normally Accept Advance Payments
As a general rule, EuroJobsCenter does not require applicants to pay the recruitment
fee in advance.
Our recruitment process has been designed to protect applicants and to ensure
maximum transparency throughout the entire immigration procedure.
If anyone asks you to pay the recruitment fee at the beginning of the process, do not
make any payment until you have veriﬁed the request directly with EuroJobsCenter.

2. Official Immigration Authority Fee (EUR 411)
As part of the German immigration procedure, the official fee for the Pre-Approval
(Vorabzustimmung) is EUR 411.
This amount is paid directly by the applicant to the responsible German Immigration
Authority (Ausländerbehörde).
The payment is never made to EuroJobsCenter.
Before making the payment, always verify that the bank account belongs to the
responsible German authority.

3. Secure Escrow (Trustee) Payment System
After the official Pre-Approval (Vorabzustimmung) has been issued, and no later than
before your appointment at the German Consulate, the agreed recruitment fee is
deposited with an independent escrow trustee.
The trustee safely holds your money until the visa procedure has been completed.
If your visa is issued successfully, the trustee transfers the agreed amount to
EuroJobsCenter.
If your visa application is refused, you may request the return of your deposited funds
from the trustee in accordance with the escrow agreement.
This system has been established to provide maximum ﬁnancial security for all
applicants.

subsection_title: 4. Never Send Money to Unknown Persons
text:
4. Never Send Money to Unknown Persons
Never send money to a private individual simply because that person claims to work
with EuroJobsCenter.
Always verify the identity of the person before making any payment.
If you are uncertain, contact EuroJobsCenter directly through our official
communication channels.
You can also verify the company's official registration and details through North Data
before making any payment.

subsection_title: 5. Do Not Trust Logos, Stamps or Signatures Alone
text:
5. Do Not Trust Logos, Stamps or Signatures Alone
Modern technology makes it possible to copy company logos, official stamps,
signatures, websites and documents.
For this reason, a logo or stamp alone is not proof that a document or payment request
is genuine.
Always verify any payment instructions directly with EuroJobsCenter before transferring
money.

subsection_title: 6. Never Feel Pressured to Pay Immediately
text:
6. Never Feel Pressured to Pay Immediately
Fraudsters often create unnecessary pressure by saying:
• "You must pay today. "
• "You will lose your job offer. "
• "Your visa will be cancelled. "
• "This is your last chance. "
Do not allow anyone to pressure you into making a payment.
If you have any doubts, stop the process immediately and contact EuroJobsCenter.

7. Protect Your Personal Documents
Your passport, driving licence and other personal documents should only be shared
through official communication channels approved by EuroJobsCenter.
Never send original documents or personal information to unknown persons.

Remember
✔ Ask questions whenever something is unclear.
✔ Verify every payment.
✔ Never transfer money without written documentation.
✔ Never make payments because someone pressures you.
✔ When in doubt, contact EuroJobsCenter ﬁrst.
Your safety is our priority.
A successful career begins with a safe and transparent recruitment process.
